peak_rule: Peak: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri excl. CN public holidays; off-peak (incl. weekends and CN holidays in full) = exactly half peak. v1 basis: peak (D-018/D-022).
bucket_mapping: input <- cache-miss input; cache_read <- cache-hit input; output <- output; cache_write/reasoning: no card line -> 0 (D-021 rough-estimate path).
notes: Official USD card fetched from the source URL on 2026-11-02; the CNY table on the same page cross-checks at ~6.67 USD/CNY.
Legacy names deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are retired; requests are served by deepseek-flash at the same price.
Search/Fetch per-request APIs ($0.75 per 1,000 requests) are out of scope: ROI prices token usage only.
Refresh is a manual action (re-fetch + commit with a new as_of date); no silent runtime network calls (privacy-first).
